items.text: LIRR, Metro-North, and NJ Transit departures now show each train’s line as a colored badge in its official line colors, so the line is easy to tell apart from the destination.
Train and ferry cards now fit more departures in the same space, so bigger cards show more of what is coming next.
Every hour now shows its chance of rain, marked with a small droplet. Tall weather cards draw a bigger temperature curve, and calm nights read calm.
If an update ever goes wrong, the display explains what happened, keeps retrying, and recovers on its own instead of going dark.
The guide now opens with the Room & Board logo and a photo of a real board in action. Tap the photo for a full-screen look. The setup steps also now match how setup actually works.
Tap any post to read it full screen, with a QR code to keep reading on your phone. Cards also fill their space with more posts.
Departures now stay accurate all day.
The dashboard automatically fits companion panels like the Cisco Room Navigator. No more pinch to zoom.
Tap a headline for its summary and a QR code to the full article. The board itself never navigates away.
roomboard.app/info went live.
Sparklines and the temperature trend draw as smooth curves, tinted by the day’s direction.
A sharper, recurated vocabulary.
A curated scenery collection, available as a screensaver or a dashboard card.
An optional daily photo backdrop behind the clock faces. Swipe to see the next one.
The tournament card signed off with Congratulations, Spain!
A dedicated settings page and three full-screen clock faces.
Golf (PGA) and Tennis leaderboards.
Tap any unconfigured card to jump straight to its settings.
Shows your next game after a final instead of going quiet.
Split into iCloud and Google Drive widgets, each with a guided phone setup.
Grand Central support, and departures stay live even when the MTA’s data feed stalls.
Markets, Subway and others fit more at every size.
The Momentum theme became the board’s look. Pure black, calmer type, quieter color.
Choose 12-hour or 24-hour time everywhere.
NJ Transit, PATH, World Clock and Chart of the Day.
Amtrak departures from Moynihan Train Hall, and Formula 1.
The first two weeks built the board itself: more than 25 widgets, phone setup at roomboard.app/setup, screensavers, and pairing codes.
